name: chordplus
title: CHORD+ chord keyboard
summary: Shift + insert turns the synth keyboard into a chord keyboard: white keys play the seven chords of the chosen key and scale (C = I ... B = vii), held black keys change the next chord (C# major/minor, D# 7th, F# sus4, G# 9th, A# inversion). Panel (shown when turned on): KEY, SCALE (7 modes), VOICING (close, voice-leading, open, bass), STRUM. Chord notes pass through the rest of the keyboard chain, so the quantizer still applies (not to strummed chords). MIDI and sequencers get the plain keys.
controls: shift + insert: CHORD+ on (panel opens) / panel again / off (while the panel is open)
panel (5 s after the last change): blue KEY, green SCALE, white VOICING, orange STRUM

synth keyboard while on: white keys = chords, held black keys = modifiers (no sound): lower octave C# min/maj, D# 7th, F# sus4, G# 9th, A# 1st inversion; upper octave C# power, D# sus2, F# OPEN, G# WIDE voicing, A# 2nd inversion (both A#: 3rd)
insert (plain) while the panel shows: pin it (stays, no timeout) / unpin (closes); panel closed: insert is TE's
status_note: 0.5: insert pins the panel; 0.4: upper-octave black keys (power, sus2, OPEN / WIDE voicing, inversions), panel 5 s, slash chord names; v0.3 device-verified (user: 'chord+ is nice'); v0.3 bigger panel, v0.2 shift + insert
